newsitem.title: USA: American BioMed talking to possible buyers.
newsitem.headline: American BioMed talking to possible buyers.

text.p: American BioMed Inc said Thursday it was in discussions with five potential buyers and partners.
The company said it signed confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements with one international and four U.S. medical device companies.

Of the four U.S. suitors, the largest had a $10.1 billion market capitalization, while the second biggest had a market capitalization of $1.5 billion, the company said. Another was a $650 million division of a private company and the smallest one had a $217 million market capitalization, it said.
American BioMed said the international suitor was a $560 million division of a major European multi-national corporation capitalized at over $5 billion.
"Initiating these discussions is a direct result of the company positioning itself to further its strategic plan," said Steven Rash, president and chief executive officer.
He said while the company was optimistic about the outcome of talks, it could make no guarantees about a complete company sale or strategic alliance.
